_doc: TRACK B pre-registration. Written BEFORE any amplifier deck exists. Goal: replace the FREE PARAMETER eta_amp (the sustaining amplifier of the QAL free-running 5-harmonic resonant gate network) with a MEASURED number from a real SG13G2/PSP103 device simulation, and restate the admission.
agent: track B (sustaining amplifier). Track A (park driver) is a different agent; my decks are independent.

step_0_ENUMERATION_of_every_remaining_ID._rule: the campaign's own lesson: three times a term booked from an ideal source later killed the result (cells' gate burn; the hop's ideal PWL gate drives 3.56 booked / 399.8 real; the park driver 2.403 booked / 15.0-15.5 real). Enumerate BEFORE measuring.

I2_sustaining_amplifier.booked: a bare efficiency parameter eta_amp; the device has NEVER been simulated

I3_tap_DC_bias_supply.status: PARTIALLY KNOWN -- BOUND, NOT MEASURED (SKEPTIC_RESULTS b_recursion_audit)
I3_tap_DC_bias_supply.fact: the taps take a NET DC charge per cycle (gt +0.6234 fC, gtp +1.1837 fC). A free-running LC network cannot source net DC. Booked at the ideal sources' instantaneous voltage; referenced to the 1.5 V rail the extra is <= 1.807 fC * 1.5 V = 2.71 fJ.
I3_tap_DC_bias_supply.my_addition: this term is STRUCTURAL, not incidental: gt must sit at DC 0.85 V and gtp at DC 0.41 V, a 0.44 V DC DIFFERENCE across what is otherwise a perfectly antiphase differential pair (AC parts are exactly +0.75*h and -0.75*h). An inductor is a DC short, so the two taps CANNOT be the two ends of one differential inductor: the resonant loop must contain a DC-blocking capacitor (extra series loss, lower effective C, lower Q) or the two taps need separate feeds. I will cost this, not assume it.

I4_the_6_ps_gtp_PHASE_ADVANCE.status: NEWLY FLAGGED BY ME -- candidate THIRD ideal-source term
I4_the_6_ps_gtp_PHASE_ADVANCE.fact: the admitted network row is m1d_h5b580_adv6: the gtp tap is phase-ADVANCED 6 ps (3.72 deg at f0=1.7241 GHz) so the pMOS cuts early-or-with the nMOS. On a PWL source that advance is a free function argument. On a real shared differential tank the two ends are at EXACTLY 180 deg; any deviation needs a real phase-shifting element with real loss, or a second tap point on a distributed network.
I4_the_6_ps_gtp_PHASE_ADVANCE.pre_stated_test: (a) does the cut order still PASS at adv=0 (exact antiphase)? If yes the advance is not load-bearing and costs nothing. If no, the advance is load-bearing and its generator must be costed -> a THIRD ideal-source term. (b) whatever phase the REAL tank+amplifier actually produces is what the completeness gates are evaluated against -- the test is built into the track-B deck.

I5_tank_series_R_and_Q.fact: shared series R <= 8.4 ohm at B=64, L1 = 5.9 nH, Q >= 7 -- all ASSUMED/DERIVED, never measured against a real inductor model. The 3rd and 5th harmonic tanks at 5.17 and 8.62 GHz need their own Q and have never been considered.
I5_tank_series_R_and_Q.my_treatment: I will report the Q the measured amplifier can actually SUSTAIN and the R that the measured eta implies, and cross-check against the required Q >= 7 that the CUT ORDER (not energy) sets.

I6_VHI_1p5V_pMOS_bulk_rail.status: MEASURED BUT UNBOOKED (flagged by the skeptic, still not in any ledger)
I6_VHI_1p5V_pMOS_bulk_rail.note: 35% of the entire 12.7467 fJ budget with no home in the hop or timer ledger. NOT an ideal source -- a real rail nobody has charged. I re-flag it; it is not mine to fix but any 'ADMITTED' verdict that omits it is void.

I7_amplifier_own_bias_and_startup.fact: tail current source gate bias, any reference, any startup circuit, any clock. Counted, not assumed. If it needs a clock, that is reported LOUDLY as a failure of the QAL premise.

step_1_the_admission_ARITHMETIC_reverse_.E_res_total_fJ: 2.974 (gt/gtp resonant pair, MEASURED) + E_park_resonant (track A; the campaign's comfortable case assumes 1.5) = 4.474
step_1_the_admission_ARITHMETIC_reverse_.check_zero_bias: 4.474 / 12.7467 = 0.35099 -> 35.1 pct. REPRODUCES the stated requirement exactly.
step_1_the_admission_ARITHMETIC_reverse_.therefore: eta_amp is DRIVER-REFERENCED: eta_amp = (energy the network DELIVERS INTO THE TAPS) / (energy the amplifier DRAWS FROM ITS SUPPLY). The tank's own R loss and the amplifier's device loss both sit in the DENOMINATOR's excess, i.e. they make eta worse. This is the number I must measure.
step_1_the_admission_ARITHMETIC_reverse_.N_min: reported through the committed unmodified qal/zcd/restate_admission.py

step_2_definitions_fixed_before_measurem.eta_amp_TAP: B * E_tap_per_bank_per_beat / E_supply_total_per_beat. THE ADMISSION NUMBER.
step_2_definitions_fixed_before_measurem.eta_amp_CORE: E_delivered_by_the_active_device_into_the_tank_node / E_supply_total_per_beat. Device-level conversion efficiency. eta_TAP = eta_CORE * (tap loss / total tank loss).
step_2_definitions_fixed_before_measurem.E_tap: net energy per beat absorbed by the gt and gtp taps of ONE bank, i.e. the quantity the committed ledger books as 2.974 fJ (skeptic-verified).
step_2_definitions_fixed_before_measurem.B: banks sharing one network; record value 64. The network scales R->R/B, C->B*C, L->L/B (Q B-invariant). I simulate the B=1 impedance-scaled equivalent and state the scaling; amplifier device width scales with B so eta is B-invariant to first order -- I will say so explicitly and flag any term that is NOT.
step_2_definitions_fixed_before_measurem.metering: 1F-integrator (CXe/BXe) or INTEG-I(Vsrc)+PARAM forms ONLY. '.measure INTEGRAL V(<B-source>)' is forbidden (under-reports 11-44 pct). Every rail/tank that sources or sinks charge gets its own integrator and the ledger must CLOSE. Headline row cross-checked by an independent trapezoid reconstruction that never touches the primary instrument.

step_3_ACCEPTANCE_pre_stated.B0_instrument_gate: re-run the committed sk_best.cir unmodified under MY OWN private PYMS_VAE_CACHE and reproduce the headline resonant-pair numbers. FAIL -> stop, the instrument is not trustworthy.
step_3_ACCEPTANCE_pre_stated.B1_steady_state: with NO external clock, the tank amplitude at the gt/gtp taps must hold within +/-2 pct over the last 5 beats of a run of >= 10 beats, starting from a cold (or lightly kicked) tank. Report the amplitude trajectory. Droop or unbounded growth = FAIL of amplitude regulation and must be reported as such.
step_3_ACCEPTANCE_pre_stated.B2_waveform_fidelity_and_COMPLETENESS: the taps produced by the REAL amplifier + REAL tank must still pass every completeness gate of the hop, evaluated at the PRE-REGISTERED checkpoint tD = 811.755 ps: CUT ORDER (pMOS cuts early-or-with nMOS, park closes AFTER the nMOS cut and holds), VBEND in the pre-registered band (real-drive ref 0.6846, ideal 0.6759), VA_open ~ 0.098, all 8 cells settle, E_hop_open at/near 8.109-8.383 fJ. A row failing any gate is INVALID, not a result.
step_3_ACCEPTANCE_pre_stated.B3_eta: eta_amp_TAP MEASURED with a ledger that closes to < 1 pct: E_supply = E_taps + E_tank_R + E_amplifier_device + dE_stored.
step_3_ACCEPTANCE_pre_stated.B4_control_cost: every bias, switch, reference and clock the amplifier needs, COUNTED in fJ/bank/hop, not assumed. If a clock is required, say so loudly.
step_3_ACCEPTANCE_pre_stated.B5_Q: the loaded Q the amplifier actually sustains, cross-checked against the required Q >= 7 that the CUT ORDER sets (large tank R makes the RC-lagged gtp tap cut late -- the v1 failure). Energy alone would allow Q ~ 2.4; the binding constraint is the cut order.

step_4_VERDICT_RULE.ADMITTED_iff: the COMPLETE ledger -- resonant gt/gtp + park tap + every holder/clamp gate + the sustaining amplifier's replenishment loss + any DC bias -- is <= 12.7467 fJ/bank/hop WITH every completeness gate PASS.
step_4_VERDICT_RULE.reporting: fJ/bank/hop ONLY. NEVER a recovery percentage as an admission result (eta is load-referenced, the admission line is driver-referenced; the campaign's as-built ratio is 7.0x).
step_4_VERDICT_RULE.labels: every number labelled MEASURED / DERIVED / ASSUMED. Negative results are first-class.

step_5_PRE_STATED_PREDICTION_so_it_canno._why: an analytic ceiling stated before the first deck, so a later measurement cannot be rationalised.
step_5_PRE_STATED_PREDICTION_so_it_canno.class_B_current_biased_cross_coupled_cei: eta_CORE_max = 2*V_amp/(pi*V_DD) for an ideal hard-commutating current-biased cross-coupled pair (V_amp = single-ended AC amplitude). With the REQUIRED V_amp = 0.75 V and V_DD = 1.5 V this is 31.8 pct -- ALREADY BELOW the 35.1-44.6 pct requirement before any real device loss, any tank R loss, or any bias cost is added.
step_5_PRE_STATED_PREDICTION_so_it_canno.implication_stated_up_front: if that ceiling is real, the classic current-biased core CANNOT clear the line at V_DD = 1.5 V, and the only escapes are (i) a tank supply rail near the required swing (V_DD ~ 0.85 V -> ceiling 56 pct), (ii) a tail-less / class-D switching core, or (iii) a lower required swing. I will test (i) and (ii).
step_5_PRE_STATED_PREDICTION_so_it_canno.tank_loss_split_prediction: tap load alone gives loaded Q ~ 10.7 (DERIVED: E_stored ~ 324 fJ at B=64 vs 190 fJ/beat tap loss). Forcing total Q = 7 leaves only ~101 fJ/beat (1.58 fJ/bank) for the tank's own R. Hence eta_TAP <= eta_CORE * 190/291 = 0.65*eta_CORE at Q=7: eta_CORE must exceed 54-69 pct for admission.
step_5_PRE_STATED_PREDICTION_so_it_canno.negative_swing_hazard: gtp must reach -0.34 V. On a bulk NMOS core the drain-substrate junction is then forward-biased by 0.34 V. Flagged before measurement.
